about: The words a clip's `setup` and `steps` may use (main/qa_clips.gd, client/README.md "Clips and tune"). Each word lists its arguments: a type (bool, number with min and max, rite, enemy, point, path, owners, candle_group) and whether it is required. The Discord agent's runner checks a clip request against the branch's copy of this file before it goes to a team PC, so a new word is an entry here, its handler in qa_clips.gd (SETUP_WORDS / STEP_WORDS) and a check in tests/qa_shots.gd; nothing in the runner.

hud.help: show the HUD while recording (it is hidden when this is left out)

stand_ins.help: the stand-in enemies: their kind, their health as a multiple of their normal health (400 when this is left out, so nothing dies), whether they may hurt the hero (not when this is left out), whether they come at the hero and fight (they stand where they are put when this is left out) and how far ahead of the hero they start, in metres (the pack's middle 8 m ahead, a line from 4 m, when this is left out; a melee rite such as scythe_sweep reaches about 3 m)

souls.help: the Reaper's souls when the recording starts (a full bag when this is left out); held to her bag's size

top_up.help: whether the hero's souls or essence are filled before each cast (they are when this is left out); off shows what a cast really costs

stand_at.help: stand the hero at this point [x, z] of the area instead of at its waystone (before the stand-ins are placed, so they start ahead of that point)

zoom.help: the camera's zoom for the clip (1 the game's default, 0.7 the closest a player can zoom, 1.45 the widest; it is 1 when this is left out): closer than a player gets is for looking at a detail

thralls.help: raise thralls for the hero ("mine", who wears the plan's "legion" kit) and for stand-in owners of other disciplines standing 9 m to either side or 8 m up the screen, as {"mine": [kinds], "gravecaller": [kinds], ...} (at most 40 thralls of 4 owners); they cannot be hurt and fight the stand-in enemies, so give those health to lose (stand_ins health) and make them come (fight)

cast.help: cast a rite at `at` seconds into the clip, aimed at the stand-ins; a rite that is busy or cooling down is tried again each frame. A clip with cast steps casts nothing by itself

walk.help: the hero walks (real movement, so the water he wades rings) to a point [x, z] of the area, or along a list of up to 8 of them one after the other, from `at` seconds into the clip

candles.help: put a Bell Sanctum candle group (west, east or north) out at `at` seconds, or light it again with out false; groups still out are lit after the clip
